args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate was 0.18). I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback reported status rolled_out with all three regions on v2.3.0. v2.3.1 was marked unhealthy in production. v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy, but only in staging. Next steps: confirm error rate and health checks recover on v2.3.0, and investigate the v2.3.1 failure before any re-release.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollout reported `rolled_out`, with every region on v2.3.0.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It is the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 is the unhealthy production release, and v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging only.
- **Before the rollback:** all regions were on v2.3.1, which was unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api. It describes the rollback and paged the on-call engineer.

I haven't confirmed that health checks and the error rate have recovered on v2.3.0. The next step is to check `get_service_status` for checkout-api.

content.text: The most recent release that was healthy in production is v2.3.0. The current production version, v2.3.1, is unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc is a staging-only build. I'll roll back to v2.3.0.
